protocol.clip_selection: Repeat 0 for every command and group, irrespective of outcome.
protocol.reference: Exact two-second controller-library window supplied in the displayed trial.
protocol.rendering: Saved Isaac Sim states at seconds 5–15, nearest 50 Hz state at each 30 fps video frame. MuJoCo is a kinematic renderer, not a new dynamics test. Failed trials hold the last alive state.
protocol.style_metric: Mean reference-consensus cosine over available scored windows and trials; missing scores are not set to zero. No style pass threshold.
protocol.source_support: Original saved recorded-velocity support mask; not a policy-training holdout mask.

old_issue: The development viewer had no zero-yaw velocity-matched reference for group 5. Its recordings are turning motions (minimum absolute mean yaw rate 2.10 rad/s), so the website explicitly falls back to the actual controller-conditioning reference.
